description: Manual DCGAN baseline — architecture follows Radford et al. (2015) DCGAN guidelines exactly. Generator uses ReLU + BatchNorm + no dropout + no residual. Discriminator uses LeakyReLU + BatchNorm + no residual. latent_dim=100 (DCGAN standard). No data augmentation during training.
paper_reference: Radford, A., Metz, L., & Chintala, S. (2015). Unsupervised Representation Learning with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks. arXiv:1511.06434
